title: Wiggle-Wondering Wrasse
statement: A thumb-sized, rainbow-shimmering wrasse who lives in a lantern-lit grotto of shells, seaweed bookmarks, and smooth pebbles, blowing a delighted 'blip!' of bubbles at every new sparkle. By day it rearranges its pebbles into tiny poems; by night it drifts to sleep curled in a teacup-sized conch, dreaming of undiscovered corners of its tank.
